description: Start an OAuth flow to connect a CRM-native social media provider account (Facebook, Instagram, Google, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, TikTok). NOTE: Reddit OAuth is handled separately via the 0nMCP reddit connection — see connect_service with service='reddit'.

locationId.description: Location ID to connect the account to

originUrl.description: URL to redirect back to after OAuth completes

page.description: Specific page or profile to connect

reconnectAccountId.description: Account ID to reconnect if re-authenticating an existing account

userId.description: User ID initiating the OAuth flow

name: crm_start_social_oauth
